truths.CP2:
SELECT SUM(s.units)
FROM sales AS s
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
truths.CP4:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN ol.quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(ol.quantity), 1)
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Headphones'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'

CP1.explanation: ASP weights every unit sold, so it is total net revenue over total units; an average of line prices counts a one-unit line as much as a ten-unit line.

CP5.explanation: ASP mixes price, promotions and product mix, so a fall alone does not show a list price cut; volume does not set ASP, and margin also depends on cost.
